description: Anteil Windenergie am Stromverbrauch is a series of datasets listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by open.bydata. Die Karte zeigt die Bedeutung der Windenergie für die Stromversorgung der Landkreise in Bayern. Die Stromerzeugung aus Windenergie wird zum Stromverbrauch des Landkreises ins Verhältnis gesetzt. Es handelt sich um berechnete Werte. Coverage: open.bydata. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher open.bydata. Its tags are anteile, energie-atlas, gdiby, gemittelt, gesamtstromverbräuche. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
